title: Why Does Your Phone Go Dark Through Sunglasses?
pause_note: 'long' lists beat indices followed by a pause; Short: 0.6 s

beats: Why does your phone go dark through sunglasses?
Tilt your head, and the picture usually comes back.
Light is a wave, and it can wiggle in any direction.
Many phone screens only let out light that wiggles one way.
Polarized sunglasses are a filter too.
Worn upright, they only pass up-and-down wiggles, to block the glare off roads and water.
Line the two filters up, and the light gets through.
Turn one a quarter turn, and they cross. Almost nothing passes.
Your screen never switched off. Your glasses just blocked it.
